mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room (chat_request_id, chat_title, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{chatRequestId}, #{chatTitle}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET last_message_at = #{lastMessageAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE chat_room SET
hidden_by_a = true, left_at_a = NOW()
hidden_by_b = true, left_at_b = NOW()
WHERE id = #{chatRoomId}
UPDATE chat_room SET hidden_by_a = false, left_at_a = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE chat_room SET hidden_by_b = false, left_at_b = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT cr.*, cr2.requester_id, cr2.responder_id FROM chat_room cr LEFT JOIN chat_request cr2 ON cr.chat_request_id = cr2.chat_request_id WHERE ( (cr2.requester_id = #{userId} AND cr.hidden_by_a = false) OR (cr2.responder_id = #{userId} AND cr.hidden_by_b = false) ) ORDER BY cr.updated_at DESC
